mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT(building) FROM bed_mgmt WHERE deleted = 0 ORDER BY building ASC
SELECT COUNT(IF(assign_time is not null, 1, NULL)) AS assignCount, COUNT(IF(adjust_time is not null, 1, NULL)) AS adjustCount FROM bed_mgmt WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT COUNT(IF(assign_time is not null and TO_DAYS(assign_time) = TO_DAYS(NOW()), 1, NULL)) AS newAssignCount, COUNT(IF(adjust_time is not null and TO_DAYS(adjust_time) = TO_DAYS(NOW()), 1, NULL)) AS newAdjustCount FROM bed_mgmt WHERE deleted = 0

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(assign_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS assignTime, COUNT(IF(assign_time is not null, 1, NULL)) AS assign FROM bed_mgmt WHERE deleted = 0 and (assign_time between date_sub(now(), interval 7 DAY) and now()) GROUP BY assignTime

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(adjust_time, '%Y-%m-%d') AS adjustTime, COUNT(IF(adjust_time is not null, 1, NULL)) AS adjust FROM bed_mgmt WHERE deleted = 0 and (adjust_time between date_sub(now(), interval 7 DAY) and now()) GROUP BY adjustTime
